title: Amazon Web Services STS temporary access key: one-property twin (length)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: a 15-character body vs exactly 16 and length: a 17-character body vs exactly 16. Twin of "Amazon Web Services STS temporary access key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of aws-sts-temporary-access-key-dotenv: length: a 15-character body vs exactly 16. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
